candidate.answerReason: One shaded part is one eighth of the sheet. Since 125 × 8 = 1000, each eighth contains 125 thousandths, or 0.125.

methods.label: Equal shares in thousandths
methods.explanation: Each part is \(\frac{1}{8}\) of the sheet. To find its decimal value, think of one whole as \(1000\) thousandths. Since \(125\times8=1000\), sharing these thousandths equally among \(8\) parts gives \(125\) thousandths per part. The first three places after the decimal point represent tenths, hundredths, and thousandths. Thus \(125\) thousandths is \(1\) tenth, \(2\) hundredths, and \(5\) thousandths, written \(0.125\). Since \(1\div8=\frac{1}{8}=0.125\), the requested decimal answer is \(0.125\).
